Name: I dropped a coin in the mountains and now i can see it
Author: undare
Description:
[b][size=4]First of all, please dont be rude in the comments, making a [color=#e69138]coin [/color]proportional to the view of the mountains in a space of 1x1 pixels was challenge in itself.

I can´t explain what i was doing in the mountains and i dont plan to go back for the [color=#e69138]coin[/color].
I made this mod for myself, but i tought to share with people.

The [color=#e69138]coin [/color]is only visible in Spring (i think), is not visible on Summer or fall because i think is covered in leaves or branches.
I can try to make it visible in Winter tho.

It should be compatible with any other mod, as i took my time to make it an "[color=#6fa8dc]overlay[/color]" mod. (so it doesnt affect the base art of the game or other mods)



Much [color=#e06666]love[/color] and i hope you are having a great day! you deserve it![color=#e06666] <3 [/color]

[/size][/b]
